norms.heading: Validity and enforceability of antenuptial agreements
norms.summary_rule: Missouri courts enforce an antenuptial agreement when it was entered into “freely, fairly, knowingly, understandingly and in good faith and with full disclosure”, and when it is not unconscionable. [FIXTURE — quotation not yet verified against the opinion.]
